name: OxaPay Crypto Payment Gateway for Paid Memberships Pro
author: OxaPay

sections.description:
OxaPay is a cryptocurrency payment gateway that enables businesses to accept payments in multiple digital currencies securely.

With OxaPay, merchants can expand their customer base by offering a fast and convenient blockchain based payment method, fully integrated with Paid Memberships Pro.

The OxaPay plugin allows you to accept the following cryptocurrencies:

  • Bitcoin (BTC)
  • Ethereum (ETH)
  • BNB (BNB)
  • TRON (TRX)
  • Tether (USDT)
  • Dogecoin (DOGE)
  • Notcoin (NOT)
  • Toncoin (TON)
  • Litecoin (LTC)
  • Bitcoin Cash (BCH)
  • Polygon (MATIC)
  • Shiba Inu (SHIB)
  • Solana (SOL)
  • Monero (XMR)
  • USD Coin (USDC)
  • DOGS (DOGS)
  • Ripple (XRP)

All supported assets are managed through your OxaPay merchant account.

Features

  • Fast cryptocurrency payments with automatic confirmation
  • Seamless integration with Paid Memberships Pro
  • Support for multiple cryptocurrencies
  • Automatic membership activation after successful payment
  • Optional auto-withdrawal via the OxaPay dashboard
  • User-friendly and clean checkout experience
  • Secure payment handling via the OxaPay API

Low Transaction Fees

OxaPay applies a transparent transaction fee of 0.4%, offering a cost-effective alternative to traditional payment processors.

Easy Integration

The plugin requires minimal configuration. Simply enter your Merchant API key and start accepting crypto payments for memberships.

Secure Wallet

OxaPay provides a secure wallet for storing and managing your crypto assets through your merchant account.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services provided by OxaPay to:
* Create and manage cryptocurrency payment requests
* Monitor blockchain payment confirmations
* Update membership and order statuses automatically

Support

Documentation and setup guides are available at OxaPay Plugin For Paid Memberships Pro.

For technical assistance or questions, contact OxaPay support.

Terms

This service is provided by OxaPay. Usage is subject to OxaPay’s terms of service.
sections.installation:
1. Navigate to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Install and activate the OxaPay Crypto Payment Gateway plugin.
  3. Log in to your OxaPay merchant dashboard and retrieve your Merchant API key.
  4. Enter the Merchant API key in the OxaPay payment settings within Paid Memberships Pro.
  5. Save settings and start accepting cryptocurrency payments.
sections.faq:
How does the OxaPay crypto payment gateway plugin work?

The OxaPay crypto payment gateway plugin enables WordPress websites to accept cryptocurrency payments through Paid Memberships Pro. After installation and activation, customers can select crypto payments during the membership checkout process.

Which API endpoint is used for transaction requests?

Transaction data is sent to:
https://api.oxapay.com/v1/payment/invoice

What data does the plugin send to the OxaPay API?

The plugin sends the Merchant API key along with transaction details such as payment amount, order ID, membership level, and selected cryptocurrency.

How does the payment process work?

Merchants configure the plugin by entering their Merchant API key. During checkout, customers choose their preferred cryptocurrency and receive the corresponding wallet address and payment amount. The plugin automatically monitors blockchain transactions and activates the membership once the payment is confirmed.

Which cryptocurrencies are supported?

The plugin supports all cryptocurrencies available on the OxaPay platform, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tether, and many others.
